evidence.quote: I will more deeply explore (1) the opportunities tokenization could provide, (2) financial-stability considerations and potential challenges should the innovation scale, and (3) the Fed's role with respect to tokenization and digital assets more broadly.

To conclude, I applaud and encourage innovation in the financial system.
